_doc: Every physical response a lesson can ask a scene for: rigid contact PhysX gives, mechanisms our laws add to an asset's joints, and material interactions (what a tool does TO a workpiece, with an outcome the scene keeps). scripts/curriculum_intake.py maps each curriculum lesson to these (curriculum_bindings.json, or the 'terms' below as a fallback) and checks each one: 'law' importable, 'test' present, and 'proven_by' a scene whose last take's record has that field true. A missing interaction, or one never proven in a take, becomes a backlog task with 'needs' as its work.

interactions.what: rigid bodies touch, rest on supports, are lifted, carried and set down (PhysX contact and friction)
an asset's own revolute joint turning freely within its limits (a scissors pivot)
a door's hinge holds where it is left: friction against its turning
a button trips a latch and a spring kicks the door open a few degrees
a magnetic door gasket holding the door shut until pulled past it, and drawing it shut at the end of a close
a door's latch catching as it is pushed shut: the strike rides the latch's ramp and clicks home past a closing-force threshold
interactions.needs: a sourced latch law (the closing force and travel of an appliance door latch) run on the door's hinge, latch_kick's state re-armed when it catches; a record of the door closed and latched

interactions.what: a drawer running on its slides: rolling/sliding friction, end stops, the drawer's travel recorded
interactions.needs: the drawer asset's prismatic joints with a sourced slide friction law (behaviors), end stops at the asset's travel; a record of the travel the hand caused

interactions.what: a power tool's motor: the trigger's travel sets the output speed by the motor's law
an appliance run from its panel: time set, start pressed, the turntable turning
interactions.needs: the microwave's panel buttons as pressable parts with a state machine (time, start), and its turntable on a motor law; a record of the run

interactions.what: a wood screw turned in by a bit: it advances its pitch a turn while the thread forms, seats, tightens, strips past the stripping torque

a twist bit cutting a hole: the thrust buys the chip (Szwajka & Trzepiecinski 2018), the chip sets the torque on the chuck, the hole's bottom advances with the feed; the board keeps the hole (its convex pieces) for the tasks after
scissors closing across a sheet part it where the blades cross; repeated closes cut along a line
interactions.needs: a sheet (paper_kraft) that can part: pieces joined along a fine grid whose joins break where the blades' crossing point passes and the shear force (sourced: paper's shear strength x thickness x the length in the bite) is met; the cut's length and the two pieces recorded; a scene with a sheet held by the other hand

interactions.what: a hammer's head striking a target: the impulse measured, a nail's advance per blow against its driving resistance
interactions.needs: an impact law: the head's contact impulse read from the contact report, a nail fixture advancing per blow against a sourced withdrawal/driving resistance in wood; the blows and the nail's depth recorded

interactions.what: tweezers' arms closing under the hand's squeeze and springing open on release: one hinge at the root (the lower arm's, the upper welded) carries both steel arms' bending stiffness in series (k_theta/2); proved squeezed while floating, as a hand holds them

a screw cap on a one-turn (GPI 400) thread: seated it holds with its removal torque (half the torque it was applied with, Oberk); broken loose it turns on the thread's drag, rising a pitch a turn, leaves the thread at its end and lifts off; set back on the neck it catches, screws down and seats, and the torque it is closed with is its next hold
pills: small rigid bodies (a few mm, a fraction of a gram) resting, rolling and dropped into a bottle without tunnelling
